import unittest


def is_palindrome(s):
    return s == s[::-1]


class TestIsPalindrome(unittest.TestCase):
    """Unit tests for the is_palindrome function."""

    def test_empty_string(self):
        """Test with an empty string."""
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome(""))

    def test_single_character(self):
        """Test with a single character string."""
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome("a"))

    def test_palindrome_even_length(self):
        """Test with an even-length palindrome."""
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome("abba"))

    def test_palindrome_odd_length(self):
        """Test with an odd-length palindrome."""
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome("aba"))

    def test_not_palindrome(self):
        """Test with a string that is not a palindrome."""
        self.assertFalse(is_palindrome("hello"))

    def test_palindrome_with_spaces(self):
        """Test with a string containing spaces (case-sensitive)."""
        self.assertFalse(is_palindrome("a b"))
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome("a a"))

    def test_palindrome_with_mixed_case(self):
        """Test with mixed case strings (case-sensitive)."""
        self.assertFalse(is_palindrome("Abba"))
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome("Abba".lower()))
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome("Abba".upper()))

    def test_palindrome_numbers(self):
        """Test with numeric strings."""
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome("12321"))
        self.assertFalse(is_palindrome("12345"))

    def test_long_palindrome(self):
        """Test with a longer palindrome."""
        long_pal = "racecar"
        self.assertTrue(is_palindrome(long_pal))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
